info.title: Medical device adverse event reports by product code and quarter (FDA MAUDE via openFDA): data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Medical device adverse event reports by product code and quarter (FDA MAUDE via openFDA): Adverse event reports the FDA received about medical devices, counted by device product code and calendar quarter from 2025 Q1: reports, deaths, injuries, malfunctions and other, for the 300 product codes with the most reports and for all devices together. Counted with the openFDA device event API (licence CC0); no report row, narrative, patient or manufacturer is ever read, only counts. Reports are filed up to weeks after an event and are driven by litigation and recalls as well as by harm, so a count is not an incidence rate.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
